values.description: Where discover and select enter. Takes unsigned requests: an app is inside the trust boundary. CONSUMER_ADAPTER_PORT in .env.
Where publish enters, and what calls the four upstreams. PROVIDER_ADAPTER_PORT in .env.
Called by no request but the health check, on purpose: both its endpoints verify signatures and Postman does not sign. NETWORK_ADAPTER_PORT in .env.
The catalogue index. Reached through an adapter, not directly, so only its health check is here. DISCOVERY_PORT in .env.
Participants and capability bindings, seeded by bin/setup.py. No request here writes to it. REGISTRY_PORT in .env.
